title: Periodicity of Adams coefficients
snippet: \label{rem:adams-coefficients-periodic} Let \(\exp(G)\) denote the exponent of \(G\). Since \(g^{m+\exp(G)}=g^m\) for every \(g\in G\), one has \[ \psi^{m+\exp(G)}\chi_\varrho=\psi^m\chi_\varrho. \] Consequently \(a_{\varrho,\pi}^{(m+\exp(G))}=a_{\varrho,\pi}^{(m)}\) for all \(m\), so only finitely many Adams coefficient vectors occur. snippet: \label{thm:primitive-peter-weyl-trace} For every \(\varrho\in\Irr(G)\) and every \(n\ge 1\), \begin{equation}\label{eq:primitive-peter-weyl-trace} \pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{m\mid n}\mu(m) \sum_{\pi\in\Irr(G)} a_{\varrho,\pi}^{(m)} \Tr(A_\pi^{n/m}). \end{equation}

title: Finite trace formula for primitive coefficients
snippet: \label{cor:primitive-peter-weyl-trace} The coefficient-level primitive data are finite-state data. More precisely, the finite character table of \(G\), the Adams coefficients \(a_{\varrho,\pi}^{(m)}\), and the twisted trace sequences \(\{\Tr(A_\pi^k):k\ge1,\ \pi\in\Irr(G)\}\) determine every primitive Peter--Weyl coefficient \(\pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau)\). title: Conjugacy-class primitive decomposition
snippet: \label{prop:class-primitive-decomposition} Let \(C\subset G\) be a conjugacy class. snippet: \label{lem:class-primitive-trivial-split} For every conjugacy class \(C\subset G\) and every \(n\ge 1\), \[ p_{n,C} = \frac{|C|}{|G|}p_n(A) +\frac{|C|}{|G|} \sum_{\varrho\neq\mathbf 1} \chi_\varrho^\ast(C)\,\pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau). \]

title: Non-trivial Peter--Weyl channel bound
snippet: \label{lem:nontrivial-peter-weyl-channel-bound} For every non-trivial \(\varrho\in\Irr(G)\) and every \(n\ge 1\), \[ \abs{\pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau)} \le \frac{|V|\,\dim\varrho\,\eta^n}{n} +\frac{|V|\,\dim\varrho}{n} \left(\sum_{\kappa\in\Irr(G)}\dim\kappa\right) \sum_{\substack{m\mid n\\ m>1}}\lambda^{n/m}, \] and therefore \[ \abs{\pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau)} \le \frac{|V|\,\dim\varrho\,\eta^n}{n} +\frac{|V|\,\dim\varrho}{n} \left(\sum_{\kappa\in\Irr(G)}\dim\kappa\right) \frac{\lambda^{n/2+1}}{\lambda-1}. \] In particular, \[ \pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau) =O\!\left(\frac{\max\{\eta^n,\lambda^{n/2}\}}{n}\right). \]

title: Absolute convergence at the Perron point
snippet: \label{lem:nontrivial-perron-point-convergence} Assume \(\lambda>1\) and \(\eta<\lambda\). Then, for every non-trivial \(\varrho\in\Irr(G)\), the series \[ \Pi_\varrho(\lambda^{-1}) =\sum_{n\ge 1}\pi_{n,\varrho}(A,\tau)\lambda^{-n} \] converges absolutely.

title: Abel limit equals the ordinary correction sum
snippet: \label{lem:abel-correction-sum} Let \(A\) be a primitive non-negative matrix with Perron root \(\lambda>1\). If \[ \sum_{n\ge 1}\left|\frac{p_n(A)}{\lambda^n}-\frac{1}{n}\right| <\infty, \] then \[ \FP(A) = \sum_{n\ge 1}\left(\frac{p_n(A)}{\lambda^n}-\frac{1}{n}\right). \] Equivalently, for every \(0\le r<1\), \[ P_A(r)+\log(1-r) = \sum_{n\ge 1}\left(\frac{p_n(A)}{\lambda^n}-\frac{1}{n}\right)r^n, \] and the limit \(r\uparrow 1\) may be passed termwise.

title: Geometric-harmonic tails
snippet: \label{lem:geometric-harmonic-tail} If \(0<\vartheta<1\), then for every \(N\ge 1\), \[ \sum_{n>N}\frac{\vartheta^n}{n} \le \frac{\vartheta^{N+1}}{(N+1)(1-\vartheta)}. \] In particular, if \(b_n=O(\vartheta^n/n)\), then \[ \sum_{n>N}b_n=O\!\left(\frac{\vartheta^N}{N}\right). \]

title: Harmonic-log remainder bound
snippet: \label{lem:harmonic-log-remainder} For every \(N\ge 1\), \[ 0 < H_N-\log N-\gamma \le \frac{1}{N+1}. \]
